recipes.name: rust-handoff-core-tests
recipes.purpose: Exercise direct offer claiming, withdrawal publication and reuse, insufficient-output preservation, duplicate payload distinction, bounded LIFO behavior, and concurrent MPMC conservation through the changed implementation.

recipes.name: handoff-static-check
recipes.purpose: Confirm the determining source path contains fixed tagged offer-cell states, bounded handoff and global fallback transitions, retained tagged heads, and preallocated slot storage.

recipes.name: abi-export-check
recipes.command: test -f stack-candidate.so && for symbol in vsst_abi_version vsst_stack_create vsst_stack_destroy vsst_producer_create vsst_producer_destroy vsst_consumer_create vsst_consumer_destroy vsst_try_push vsst_try_pop; do nm -D --defined-only stack-candidate.so | awk '{print $3}' | rg -qx "$symbol" || exit 1; done
recipes.purpose: Confirm the materialized candidate artifact exists and exports every required copying C ABI symbol.
